Where the camera is, what it looks at, its yaw, pitch (degrees below the horizon) and distance, its field of view, what moves it, whether a camera path holds it, the mouse hints (rotate, pitch, top) the cursor's place offers and what a drag has turned into

Puts the camera somewhere at once, still, as the scripts place it; what isn't given is kept. It stays there until the player or a script moves it: an easing under way is forgotten, but a drag, turn or tilt the player holds continues from its own start. As in the game, a world camera flight that has started stops there until a camera control or a move back inside the world, and one not started yet starts from there. The world camera's own rules still apply (what it looks at slides onto the land ahead, it keeps its height over the land, the fence and the self-tilting camera). Refused while a script or a camera path holds the camera, unless override, which shows it there every frame over any camera until camera.release. warnings (without override) say what will move it on at once: another camera than the world's (creature, temple...), or the camera fence or height limit the land's script set, which the world camera keeps to every frame

The game's menu: any control of the page it shows (buttons, check boxes, sliders in their middle, tabs) or of the question it asks, as gui.windows lists them; path [n] for the n-th of a name. The start-of-game question (skip_box): OK, or an answer's radio button by its answer or by normal, creature, story, old or cow. The tattoo_editor: OK or Cancel. The multiplayer front end (multiplayer): the controls of its box, or of its message, by name. The music_player: its buttons by name (Music, Play, Pause, Stop, Previous, Next, Rewind, Fast Forward, Shuffle, Repeat, Play List) while they show. The end box (end_box): its tabs and arrows by name. The game's dialogs are clicked through the game's input, in order behind any input still to come. A debug window's button inside a table row or another scope its window pushed needs path: the labels and numbers leading to it.
